name: Tsukishima
excerpt: Tsukishima is a student who often observes and comments on the interactions between his peers.
notes: Tsukishima is a student who prefers to sit with people he knows rather than strangers. He often observes and comments on the interactions between Hinata and Kageyama, finding them amusing and sometimes frustrating.
